scope: Static portability audit of DeepInfer main 774ce244b87cc0eb8d4b94ab9f5de2ab22049f01 into Strata. It inventories and ranks mechanisms and evidence; it does not compile, execute, benchmark, or port code.

checks.name: clone_head
checks.command: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer build/engines/DeepInfer && git rev-parse HEAD

checks.name: read_only_remote
checks.command: git remote set-url --push origin DISABLED_NO_PUSH && git remote get-url --push origin

evidence_reviewed: csrc/engine/zos.cpp and csrc/engine/zos.hpp: pinned CPU extraction and fresh-versus-previous remap
deepinfer/worker/worker.py and worker/zos_status.py: one-step forward/sample/post-process overlap
deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py, utils.py, and tests/test_cuda_sync_guards.py: launch-phase sync guards
deepinfer/model_executor/input_metadata/prepare_tensor_input_zos.py and CUDA graph runner: reusable device metadata and stacked-prefix views
csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp and block_manager.hpp: chunked prefill, LCFS preemption, CoW clones, dual object pools
csrc/engine/mtp_varlen.hpp and schedule_mtp_varlen.py: measured-cost confidence scheduling
deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/engram*.py and gather_engram_tokens_zos.py: compressed n-gram table and incremental input assembly
deepinfer/ve/multimodal_processor.py, deepinfer/shared_memory.py, and distributed/shm_broadcast.py: CPU preprocessing and host transfer paths
examples/benchmark.py, examples/README.md, and doc/inference_deployment_qa.md: published benchmark and architecture descriptions

test_and_benchmark_map.claim: Identified from source at the audit revision; tests and benchmarks were not executed in this audit.
tests: tests/test_cuda_sync_guards.py: host-safe unit coverage and CUDA-marked end-to-end guard coverage
tests/engine/test_sequence.py: compressed-token mapping boundary and sentinel cases
tests/worker/test_state_cache_ops.py: state-cache layout, store/restore, and CE transfer slices
tests/distributed/test_shm_broadcast.py and tests/worker/test_userbuffer.py: host ring and communication-buffer lifecycle
tests/engine/test_mm_overwrite_prompt.py: prompt expansion and cache-aware binary stripping
deepinfer/model_executor/layers/tilelang_ops/gather_engram_tokens_zos.py and schedule_mtp_varlen.py: GPU-vs-reference parity plus benchmark functions, requiring CUDA when run
tests/models/test_offline_inference.py and test_batch_invariant.py: model-dependent PPL and batch-invariance regression
benchmarks: examples/benchmark.py: steady prefill/decode windows, ZOS tag in output name, optional torch profiler
examples/sweep/run_sweep.sh plus plot_pareto.py: throughput-latency Pareto sweeps
examples/README.md: named hardware, warmup/measurement windows, profiler-overhead warnings

non_claims: No DeepInfer test, model run, profiler, or benchmark was executed.
No portability ranking proves runtime speed or memory improvement on Strata hardware.
No upstream repository was modified, pushed to, opened against, or downloaded beyond the requested shallow source clone.
The DeepInfer Engram tables and tokenizer are model-specific artifacts; this audit does not make them compatible with Strata's qwen4exp PLE table.
The clone contains submodule references but vendor submodules were not initialized.
